definitions.explanation: One of the ten standard cloud genera: puffy, cotton-like clouds with flat bases and rounded tops, typically forming on fair-weather days by thermal convection in the lower atmosphere.

examples.japanese: ⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{積雲|せきうん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{浮|う}かぶ→浮かぶ：03916_ukabu⟧。
examples.english: Cumulus clouds float in the sky.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{午後|ごご}→午後：00544_gogo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{積雲|せきうん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{発達|はったつ}→発達：03559_hattatsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Cumulus clouds often develop well on summer afternoons.

examples.japanese: {積雲|せきうん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{白|しろ}くて→白い：00587_shiroi⟧⟦{綿|わた}→綿：00421_wata⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ような⟦{形|かたち}→形：02193_katachi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Cumulus clouds are white and shaped like cotton.

examples.japanese: {積雲|せきうん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{発達|はったつ}→発達：03559_hattatsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦やがて→やがて：03637_yagate⟧⟦{積乱雲|せきらんうん}→積乱雲：27194_sekiranun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{雷雨|らいう}→雷雨：15922_raiu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もたらす→もたらす：10546_motarasu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: When cumulus clouds develop greatly, they can eventually become cumulonimbus and bring thunderstorms.

notes:
Composed of {積|せき} (pile up, accumulate) and {雲|うん} (cloud). One of the ten standard cloud classifications (⟦{十|じゅう}→十：00708_juu⟧⟦{種|しゅ}→種：28584_shu⟧{雲形|うんけい}) used in meteorology.

USAGE:
- A technical meteorological term but widely recognized in everyday contexts (weather reports, science textbooks).
- Used as a plain noun; does not take ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {積雲|せきうん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発達|はったつ}→発達：03559_hattatsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: cumulus clouds develop
- {積雲|せきうん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{浮|う}かぶ→浮かぶ：03916_ukabu⟧: cumulus clouds float (in the sky)
- ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{積雲|せきうん}: summer cumulus clouds

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{積乱雲|せきらんうん}→積乱雲：27194_sekiranun⟧: cumulonimbus — a towering, thundercloud form developed from cumulus
- ⟦{層雲|そううん}→層雲：23703_souun⟧: stratus — flat, layered low clouds
- ⟦{巻雲|けんうん}→巻雲：21944_kenun⟧: cirrus — wispy high-altitude clouds
- ⟦{入道雲|にゅうどうぐも}→入道雲：10085_nyuudougumo⟧: thunderhead (colloquial) — everyday word for a large cumulus/cumulonimbus
